query:
UPDATE withdrawals
        SET processing_history = COALESCE(processing_history, '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
            'event_type', $2::text,
            'old_state', $3::text,
            'new_state', $4::text,
            'success', $5::boolean,
            'message', $6::text,
            'details', $7::jsonb,
            'timestamp', NOW()
        )::jsonb
        WHERE id = $1
